newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bank of Israel governor to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Israel governor to hold news conference.

text.p: Bank of Israel Governor Jacob Frenkel will hold a news conference at 1200 (0900 GMT) in Jerusalem to explain changes to the foreign exchange regime, the central bank announced.
A spokeswoman said it was likely that Frenkel would also announce a cut in its key lending rate.
Bank of Israel officials were meeting this morning to decide on the size of the cut. Israeli media has speculated the reduction would be anywhere from one to three percentage points.
The base rate is at an annual 13.9 percent, unchanged since February.

Earlier on Wednesday the Israeli cabinet approved foreign exchange reform which will enable the central bank to intervene less in the market. Finance minister Dan Meridor resigned after the emergency cabinet meeting that approved the changes.
In the past year the central bank has bought massive amounts of dollars to prevent the shekel from appreciating beyond its trading band.
